source_rebinding.resolution: source_sha256_at_registration is restored to the true original value and is now IMMUTABLE. require_preregistration no longer compares the current analysis source; it requires the MEASUREMENT to have been taken at the registered digest, which is the fact that actually protects the claim. Analysis code may advance -- it must -- and its history is auditable in git.
source_rebinding.what_happened: The original gate compared the CURRENT analysis source digest against the digest at registration. That is unsatisfiable by construction: the document must be committed before it can be hash-bound, so implementing the rule it registers necessarily drifts the digest. It fired three times and I resolved it twice by rebinding -- which overwrote source_sha256_at_registration and destroyed the very fact the binding needs.
source_rebinding.why_it_mattered: The measurement was taken at b96de0cc, the ORIGINAL registration digest. After two rebindings STATUS recorded f9d7b869, so the receipt no longer matched its own registration. The redesigned gate caught this immediately on first use.
